g.text: The top-decile cutoff in KP rural is 6.51 times the bottom-decile cutoff
Source: PSLM 2019-20. Sample: 3,396 earners aged 15-64 in KP rural.
Excluded from the histogram: 13 earners outside Rs 10,000 - Rs 10,000,000.
Weighted by hhweight; percentiles use the cumulative-weight definition.
